waypoints.name: Ingalls Creek Trailhead (Trail #1215)
waypoints.directions: From US 97 between Leavenworth and Blewett Pass, about 7 miles south of the US 2 junction (near milepost 178), turn west onto Ingalls Creek Road. Cross Peshastin Creek, bear left, and drive to the trailhead at the road's end, about 1,900 ft. A Northwest Forest Pass or Interagency pass is required to park; fill out the free self-issued wilderness permit at the trailhead.

waypoints.name: Crystal Creek Junction
waypoints.note: Leave Ingalls Creek Trail ~100 ft before it crosses Crystal Creek.

waypoints.name: Crystal Lake
waypoints.note: Basin camp below the SW Rib; also reachable descending from the Enchantments plateau.

waypoints.name: Crystal Lake Tower
waypoints.note: Westernmost point on McClellan Peak's summit ridge; SW Rib forms a continuous ~1,400-ft line down into Crystal Creek Basin.
